column25: I have been extremely unhappy with the feed and disrespect on the insta from the Siren members.  We are a support group and I don't feel this group is supportive at all.  People in this group act like they are entitled to know information that is simply none of our business.  They post negative and personal attacks on people who work at The Wave.  This is not the role of a supporters group.  We should be talking about the game and about soccer.  Not about politics and unfounded attacks and allegations that have NOTHING to do with us.  We should be complaining about our teams lack of speed.  Our teams lack of discipline.  Our outside defenders who won't mark.  Our midfield which cannot create any transition with controlled play.  The fact that we don't (although with our newest addition) a finishing forward.  We should NOT be talking politics, social justice or activism.  This is a game.  A sport.  FUN.  I am seriously considering quitting the Sirens because no one wants to discuss the team and the game of soccer, instead they want to bash people.  I think the president and the board need to re-establish the focus and the role of this group.  That role should be a supportive group of The San Diego Wave.  And, lets be real: the only reason people are negative and angry is because we weren't winning this year.  Everyone loves a winner, but the true colors come out when a team is losing.  I don't identify and don't want to be a part of a group of people who are vigilantes intent on bashing and representing people when they are uninformed and have a false sense of entitlement.  I want to surround myself with people who just want to watch soccer, or any sport, and have a constructive a fun time.  I am disappointed the president and the board have chosen to allow this group to run outside the scope of a fan club and turn this into a political social media account.

We got asked for input and multiple people responded with their distrust of her and how this team is being handled. Why ask for input if it’s just going to be ignored? If leadership are Ellis backers I think we deserve to know this. Maybe I would have voted in the leadership election for change but based on who was elected and re-elected I doubt change will happen. Especially when you have someone stating this in their bio while running “My person interest isn’t in corporate or legal proceedings; my focus will be on proactive responsibility to our sirens community and our core mission of optimizing game day experience.” We are the supporters group of a team that’s currently being sued. Our president is being sued. In a league that is being sued by former workers. This is definitely something we should pay attention to and not minimize for the sake of a good atmosphere at a game. I’ve been highly disappointed in the sirens this season and their inability to do what’s right.
